Systematic Inventive Thinking (SIT) • Function Follows Form (FFF)

How the 2,000 PayBox Ideas Were Generated & Ranked

Inspect PayBox Closed World (payboxapp.com) ↗
STEP 1 • CLOSED WORLD
12 PayBox Subsystems & 40 Variables

Extracted directly from payboxapp.com: Group Box (קבוצות), P2P Transfer (72h window), Personal Balance (up to 25k ₪), PayBox Plus Digital Visa Card (CAL), Personal Savings Box (up to 6% interest), Shared Box (Box משותף), PayBox Young, PayBox Gifts, Instant Loans, Rav-Kav NFC, PayBox Business QR, and Charity Donations.

STEP 2 • 5 SIT TEMPLATES
5 × 400 Structural Manipulations

Each template systematically manipulates internal components or attributes: Subtraction (remove essential element), Multiplication (copy + alter parameter), Division (split physically/functionally/temporally), Task Unification (assign new job to existing resource), and Attribute Dependency (couple Variable X → Variable Y).

STEP 3 • FUNCTION FOLLOWS FORM
Virtual Product (FORM) → Use (FUNCTION)

Following Ronald Finke & SIT's backwards Function Follows Form protocol, each manipulation first defines a strictly structural FORM (Virtual Product) without assuming a market need, and only then works backwards to discover the concrete FUNCTION (target users, use scenario, and pain solved).

STEP 4 • ORTHOGONAL RANKING
X = Pure FORM, Y = Pure FUNCTION

To prevent halo-effect bias, Originality (X-axis) is scored 100% from the structural FORM (breaking cognitive fixedness & morphological rarity), while Usefulness (Y-axis) is scored 100% from the FUNCTION (pain severity, reach, ecosystem retention & feasibility).

X-Axis: Originality Rating (FORM-Only Rubric)

Range: 0.0 – 100.0

Evaluates only the structural geometry of the Virtual Product (ignoring market popularity):

Originality(FORM) = 0.32·D_struct + 0.30·F_fixedness + 0.22·R_tfidf + 0.16·E_closed_world
  • • Structural Distance (32%): How essential or central the manipulated component is to PayBox's baseline architecture.
  • • Cognitive Fixedness Inversion (30%): Degree to which the Form violates structural, functional, or relational fixedness in digital wallets.
  • • Morphological TF-IDF Rarity (22%): Corpus-wide inverse document frequency of the structural operator and component pairing across all 2,000 forms.
  • • Closed-World Elegance (16%): Adherence to SIT's Closed-World condition—solving the puzzle using only existing internal or neighborhood resources.

Y-Axis: Usefulness Rating (FUNCTION-Only Rubric)

Range: 0.0 – 100.0

Evaluates only the practical utility, user value, and business impact of the discovered FUNCTION (ignoring how weird or clever the form is):

Usefulness(FUNC) = 0.34·V_pain + 0.26·F_reach + 0.22·M_ecosystem + 0.18·T_feasibility
  • • Pain-Point Severity & Value (34%): Financial loss, social friction (e.g. nagging friends), or embarrassment eliminated for the target segment.
  • • Addressable Reach & Frequency (26%): Share of PayBox users affected and frequency of trigger (daily tap vs. weekly group vs. annual event).
  • • PayBox Ecosystem & Yield Synergy (22%): Impact on keeping funds inside the 25,000 ₪ balance ecosystem, driving PayBox Plus card taps, or growing viral Group Boxes.
  • • Regulatory & Technical Feasibility (18%): Ease of deployment within Bank of Israel / CAL payment rails and existing smartphone hardware.
